name: Carousel
description: A row of cards you slide through, with snapping, round arrow buttons and dots.

props.name: slidesPerView
props.type: number | { base?: number; sm?: number; md?: number; lg?: number; xl?: number }
props.description: Slides in view at once. Per breakpoint, each value applies from that screen width up.

props.name: showArrows
props.description: Round previous and next buttons under the track. They are disabled at the ends.

props.name: showDots
props.description: One dot per position under the track; the current one stretches into a water pill as you scroll.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the carousel for assistive technology.

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous?: string; next?: string; goTo?: (index) => string; slide?: (index, count) => string }
props.description: Text for assistive technology, for translation.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of a section.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
